title: Director, Program Management
Director, Technical Program Management
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is looking for a director to help lead GitHub’s Technical Program Management team in our Engineering organization. You should be an ambitious, passionate, technical, and collaborative leader with a strong background in empowering high performing teams and an ability to deliver results through technical programs. 


The Director, TPM will strengthen TPM's role as a trusted integrator, driving clarity, accountability, and execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They will help teams frame problems, align stakeholders, and accelerate decision-making while raising the effectiveness of TPMs and scaling their influence across the company. This director will foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, and operational excellence, ensuring execution remains tightly aligned with strategic priorities. 


Responsibilities

Opportunity and Solutions Identification 

  • Demonstrates and builds experiences across multiple groups or divisions. Leads and coaches teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses for products and services across divisional boundaries to address highly complex business, program, customer needs, and/or market opportunities; identifies dependencies of other features. 

  • Determines and leads process improvements to quickly scope insights, and drives change management initiatives. Uses industry understanding to direct teams to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and the goals and strategy of GitHub. 

  • Holds teams accountable for collaborating with others (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Design) to ensure that they can satisfy customer requirements. Provides expertise to help teams validate the market size and opportunity of greatest value for the company. Facilitates collaboration between their team and other partner teams to bring about solutions. 

 

Program Planning and Success 

  • Provides expertise to help teams define the multiple program goals and prioritization for the products and services they own. Guides teams to translate the needs of the organization and other teams into program goals and prioritize deliverables based on data insights.  

  • Guides teams to engage in active risk management (proactive and reactive) to identify risks and propose mitigations for risks using data (e.g., telemetry, usage, net satisfaction, customer satisfaction). 

  • Coaches teams to define success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., Objectives and Key Results [OKRs], Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as quality and performance) of products, services and works with engineering to ensure needed telemetry is developed. Provides expert knowledge to help teams deeply understand the return on investment. 

  

Program/Service Development 

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in orchestrating and integrating efforts for the development and implementation process of product, services on large cross functional projects with internal teams and external partners. Drives teams to collaborate and coordinate across teams and perspectives to ensure alignment on product management and release, including tradeoffs, adjustments, and improvements as feasible. 

  • Guides teams to partner with the engineering team to contribute, prioritize, and deliver on the roadmap for product, service. Drives teams to understand the value proposition for the feature(s)/feature areas and answer technical questions on the feature(s)/feature areas they own.  

  • Guides teams to justify capacity requirements and advocate for the right resource allocation. Partners with the Engineering team to know the feature capabilities in alignment with the goal updates and associated tradeoffs. 

  • Guides teams tracking, coordinating, and communicating end-to-end project schedules for products, services. Ensures teams establish and monitor processes, and hold other stakeholders accountable for following the established schedule and processes. 

  • Guides teams when tracking and managing dependencies to enable cohesive, connected user scenarios, and to avoid issues and mitigate risks. Coaches teams to make adjustments or course corrections when projects are not aligned to schedules or goals. 

  • Drives teams to develop the staging and implementation plan for piloting/release in alignment with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for products, services, its development timeline, and the introduction to the different programs. Ensures teams collaborate with stakeholders to monitor progress and adjust as needed. 

  • Helps teams lead governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., quality, compliance, privacy, security, safety, accessibility). 

 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Provides expertise to help teams partner with others to collect performance metrics (e.g., Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as usage, quality, speed, and cost), monitor and report on progress (e.g., business reviews), and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action. 

  • Ensures teams share insights with Engineering and other partners. Leads teams to form hypotheses to technical needs, perform experiments, and iterate to drive improvement in specific performance metrics that have measurable impact. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • 4+ years experience designing, building, or supporting software systems. 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

Crusoe is scaling one of the fastest-growing global workplace and data center portfolios in the industry, with active real estate initiatives spanning San Francisco, Denver, London, Tel Aviv, Bellevue, and beyond, alongside a rapidly expanding global data center footprint. We're looking for a Senior Director, Real Estate & Portfolio Strategy to lead the strategy, execution, and financial management of our global co-location, manufacturing office and data center lease portfolio.

Reporting directly to the VP, DIG Operations, this role will be a critical partner in aligning our real estate strategy with business growth, headcount planning, employee experience, and long-term financial objectives across both corporate office, co-location, manufacturing and data center real estate. You'll work closely with our exclusive global brokerage partner, Legal, Finance, People, Data Center Operations, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, data-driven real estate solutions that support Crusoe's continued expansion.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior real estate leader who thrives on managing multiple concurrent transactions across office, manufacturing and data center/colocation portfolios, enjoys the financial and analytical side of commercial real estate, and wants to build scalable portfolio strategies, lease governance, and audit processes for a rapidly growing global company.

 

What You'll Be Working On

 

• Portfolio Strategy and Asset Management: by partnering with Finance, People, Workplace, and Data Center Operations leadership to translate hiring forecasts, capacity plans, and space/power utilization into real estate recommendations. Evaluate expansion, consolidation, renewal, and exit opportunities across global office and data center markets.

• Lease Portfolio Management: own the master lease abstract database across all locations, tracking key dates, terms, options, renewal windows, and obligations to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Lease Review & Abstracting: lead comprehensive lease review and abstracting for new and existing leases, including manufacturing office, data center, and cloud colocation agreements — abstracting key business, financial, and legal terms into standardized formats for portfolio-wide tracking and reporting.

• Transaction Execution: manage end-to-end real estate transactions — including new office and manufacturing leases, renewals, subleases, expansions, contractions, and terminations — in close partnership with our brokers and legal counsel.

• Cloud Colocation & Data Center Lease Management: lead ongoing lease management for cloud colocation and data center leases, including power/capacity commitments, service level agreements, interconnection terms, expansion rights, and hyperscaler lease administration.

• Critical Date Management: own the tracking and management of all critical lease dates across the portfolio — including notice periods, renewal and termination options, rent escalations, expansion/contraction windows, and compliance deadlines — ensuring proactive action ahead of key milestones.

• Financial Analysis & Reporting: build and maintain cash flow models, occupancy cost analyses, rent schedules, lease comparisons, escalations, and CAM reconciliations to support executive decision-making across office, manufacturing and data center portfolios.

• Executive Reporting: prepare business cases, portfolio updates, and executive presentations that translate complex lease and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

• Stakeholder Coordination: serve as the primary point of contact between Workplace, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Data Center Operations, and site leadership on all lease-related matters, including purchase order and approval workflows in Coupa.

• Broker & Transaction Management: serve as the relationship manager for Crusoe's global brokerage partner, leading lease negotiations, coordinating transaction strategy, and driving favorable business and financial outcomes across the portfolio.

• Compliance, Risk & Audit Management: track insurance requirements, certificates of occupancy, permits, and critical lease obligations across office and data center locations; manage lease and portfolio audits, proactively identifying and mitigating portfolio risks.

• Site Selection: partner with brokers and internal stakeholders on new market evaluations, including market analysis, site tours, financial comparisons, and lease execution for both office and manufacturing sites.

• Portfolio Systems & Process Improvement: lead the evaluation and implementation of a global lease administration platform while continuously improving portfolio reporting, documentation, and governance — including audit readiness — to support Crusoe's continued growth.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• 15+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio strategy, lease administration, or commercial real estate transaction management, including experience with data center or cloud colocation leasing.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent lease transactions across multiple geographies and asset types, including office and data center/colocation.

• Strong financial acumen, including developing business cases, cash flow projections, occupancy cost analyses, lease economics, and executive recommendations.

• Hands-on experience with lease review, abstracting, and management, including tracking of critical dates, options, and obligations across a large, complex portfolio.

• Experience negotiating commercial lease terms in partnership with brokers and legal counsel, including colocation and data center-specific terms (power, SLAs, interconnection, expansion rights).

• Experience leading or supporting lease and portfolio audits, with a strong understanding of compliance and risk management practices.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and executive leadership without direct authority.

• Experience implementing or administering lease management software is highly desirable.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets with strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex real estate and financial information for executive audiences.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving business priorities.

 

Bonus Points

• Experience working directly with a global brokerage firm (e.g., JLL, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield).

• Experience supporting international real estate transactions and global portfolios.

  • Improve engineering and operational excellence through automation, tooling, and standardization across testing, deployment, and operations.

Overview

GitHub is seeking a Staff Developer Advocate to join the GitHub Security Lab. The mission of the Security Lab is to inspire and enable the community to secure the open source software we all depend on. We create a home for security researchers where they can collaborate and share, with the common goal of making security easy for developers.


In this role, you will act as a known subject matter expert and trusted ambassador who engages with security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise developers and encourages them to get the most out of GitHub Security Lab's security tools and resources — including CodeQL, Dependabot, secret scanning, code scanning, Copilot Autofix, AI-powered vulnerability detection, and the GitHub Advisory Database.


You will define the vision and strategy for the Security Lab's developer advocacy program, producing high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, training, videos, CTFs, conference talks), leading community events, and driving social media campaigns. You will grow our community from a dedicated group of security enthusiasts to everyone who cares about software security. You will also help the security community understand and navigate the evolving intersection of AI and security — from securing AI-generated code to leveraging AI for vulnerability discovery.


As a Staff-level advocate, you bring cross-team influence and deep technical expertise across multiple areas. You don't just execute — you set direction, establish frameworks that help others produce great security content, and proactively identify highly impactful unaddressed issues, mobilizing resources to resolve them before they affect the community. You mentor and sponsor others within the team, and you use data and business outcomes to inform decisions and influence stakeholders across GitHub.


Responsibilities

Understanding the Security Community

Acts as a known subject matter expert of the security research and open source developer communities — their common experiences, goals, industry trends, and key developments — by meeting with community members, attending security and developer conferences, and engaging on social media. Possesses expert knowledge of GitHub's security products and services (CodeQL, code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot, advisory database) and their potential impact on the broader security ecosystem. Strategically seeks out influencers in the security and open source spaces to understand business drivers and community objectives. Anticipates future changes in the application security landscape, including the impact of AI on security research workflows and the emerging challenges of securing AI-generated code.

Building Trusted Relationships

Acts as a trusted and influential ambassador between the security community and GitHub's product, engineering, and marketing teams. Builds and maintains a broad, diverse network across security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise security teams. Utilizes deep understanding of community needs to share valuable insights, best practices, and technical know-how, maintaining thought leadership within the security community.

Internal Advocacy and Impact

Collects and seeks out feedback from the security community and stakeholders regarding product usage, user experience, and technical issues. Communicates clearly and effectively to relevant product groups, advocating for and influencing urgent and long-term improvements to GitHub's security features. Proactively builds and manages networks of key stakeholders and leads engagement through established and informal channels to provide feedback on priorities and emerging security scenarios. Incorporates data and key metrics into findings regarding value-add and impact of advocacy initiatives. Ensures the feedback loop between community members, the Security Lab, and the GitHub product team is effective.

Supporting Key Internal Initiatives

Builds and enhances trust with internal teams through networking and engagement regarding security product improvement plans. Acts as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders on application security and the security researcher community. Regularly engages in retrospective evaluations to inform future work.

Content Development

Defines, creates, and leads the technical content strategy for the Security Lab — blog posts, tutorials, training courses, videos, CTFs, puzzles, and conference talks — covering topics from traditional vulnerability research to AI-assisted security analysis and secure AI development practices. Drives interactions across technical forums, social media, and community channels to promote awareness and provide best practices. Represents the GitHub Security Lab at high-visibility security and developer conferences, hackathons, and meetups. Sets the standard for content quality and measures impact to continuously improve how we communicate with the security community.

Community Impact

Actively seeks out feedback and listens to the needs of the security community, responding with relevant information and upskilling others to make a substantial impact on community growth. Designs the community member journey — from first engagement to active contributor — measuring retention and engagement along the way. Proposes strategic improvements to the community experience. Manages the Security Lab's social media presence and public forums. Applies deep knowledge of GitHub's security products, stakeholders, and strategic objectives to influence and inspire the audience.

Technical Expertise

Possesses deep technical expertise in application security, secure code practices, vulnerability research, AI-assisted code analysis, and static analysis. Constantly seeks out learning and teaching opportunities and engages in conversations with key security researchers and developers to understand current developments and issues. Applies and practices technical expertise via sample code, CodeQL queries, security advisories, and demonstrations. Builds processes and systems to share technical expertise at scale and works within the industry to help inform future security developments. Understands the security implications of AI-generated code and AI-powered development tools, and can communicate best practices for secure AI adoption to both security researchers and developers. Gains broader knowledge of adjacent technologies and incorporates them into current areas of expertise.

Principal TPM, AI Engineering, AI Engineering

Job ID: 10601884 | Amazon Web Services, Inc.

Apply now

Description

Software engineering is where AI is changing work fastest. Developers everywhere now use AI coding tools, but the organizational gains have not followed, and most enterprises have faster individual developers alongside the same delivery outcomes. AWS AI Engineering exists to close that gap. We help customers systematically build better software with AI across the whole software development lifecycle. AI-native development is now moving from early adopters into the enterprise, and the hard part is no longer proving that it works. It is making it scale.

We are looking for a Principal TPM to help shape how that happens. You will work alongside our engineering teams to bring direction together from two streams of signal: what we learn inside customers' engineering organizations, and where the industry is heading. Customer signal tells you what hurts today. Industry signal tells you what will be table stakes in six months. Connecting the two into a point of view the team can act on, and keeping it current as both move, is the center of this role.

Our current work includes an open-source, AI-native development lifecycle we created and continue to evolve with customers, along with offerings that give AI agents a deep understanding of large codebases and move customers toward autonomous software delivery. Those offerings will keep changing as the technology does, and the charter behind them will not.

Key job responsibilities

Bring the direction together

Work with our engineering teams to connect customer signal and industry signal into a clear direction for how AWS helps customers become AI-native across the software development lifecycle. Find where teams are solving the same problem in parallel and bring that work together, so the organization makes one piece of real progress rather than three partial ones. Help sequence work against customer readiness and keep the portfolio coherent as individual offerings come and go.

Define the methodology, then make it adoptable

Drive the definition, standardization, and adoption of our AI-native development lifecycle as something customers can run themselves. Build consensus on the practices and standards that make it real, and replace fragmented experimentation with a credible default path that fits each customer's risk tolerance.

Own adoption, and scale it

Treat adoption as the deliverable rather than the follow-up, through enablement, documentation, reference implementations, assessments, and self-service paths that carry customers from first experiment to production-scale practice. Design the mechanisms that convert individual developer adoption into enterprise standardization and that let the wider AWS field carry this work without you in the room. Account for organizations whose constraints differ from the ones you designed for, and for the long tail where adoption usually stalls.

Define how success is measured, and hold us to it

Define and track outcome-based KPIs for the charter, including adoption and depth of use inside customer organizations, persistence of changed behavior long after the engagement, and improvements in delivery speed, quality, and the economics of building software. Insist on rigorous evaluation of the offerings we build, the agents inside them, and our own claims about what works. Build measurement frameworks customers can run on themselves, and recommend stopping work that is not paying off.

Build leverage out of engagements

Turn lessons from individual customer engagements into repeatable patterns and scalable assets. Productize what was built for one customer when it has broader value, and resist treating every new request as bespoke. Represent the voice of the customer internally, translating patterns and adoption blockers into actionable input for AWS service teams so that what we learn in the field shapes the products customers build on.

Lead across the organization and with customers

Influence without relying on authority, aligning engineering, field, and regional teams worldwide on shared direction and sequencing. Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and practitioners, solving the business problem rather than only the technical one and investing in the long-term relationship over the one-off win. Build the playbook and enablement that lets the wider AWS field carry this work, and represent it externally through open source, conference talks, and technical writing.

A day in the life

You split your time between setting direction and staying close to the work. On one day you might sit with a customer's engineering team to understand why they abandoned part of the lifecycle after week three, then meet a CTO to agree what success looks like for a 15,000 developer organization. On another you might review adoption data across regions to decide where the next investment goes, work out what a stalled rollout actually needs, or turn a pattern that worked for one customer into something the whole field can run. You make calls with incomplete information, hold direction under pressure, and change course when the evidence warrants.

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of software development experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Description

Enterprise Engineering builds and operates the internal tools, platforms, and AI-powered services that enable over 1.5 million Amazonians to do their best work every day — from endpoint management and collaboration to innovative productivity experiences, all at massive global scale. We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional, company wide projects. This role requires working closely with product management to define strategy and requirements, collecting business and systems requirements from customers and business units, writing specifications, and leading development teams from design through delivery and subsequent operation. You will be expected to make appropriate trade-offs to optimize launch timelines, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional project teams. This position involves regular communication with senior management on status, risks, and product strategy. Excellent listening, writing skills, executive communication and very strong technical competency are essential.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects through multiple complete product development cycles, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop detailed functional and test specifications, schedule, and deploy new feature sets in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high product judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent, and leadership are essential to success in this role.

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of software development experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Description

Regulation Tech Assurance (RTA) is the team responsible for maintaining global regulatory compliance for all Amazon Stores, Devices, and Others to include payment and healthcare compliance. Additionally, RTA works to identify, analyze, and mitigate privacy risk identified through various compliance activities. 

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated Principal Technical Program Manager with a background in privacy governance who will help identify, analyze, and prioritize privacy risk identified through a variety of sources across Amazon. This work will help drive leadership prioritization and reduced privacy compliance risk. The Principal Technical Program Manager will drive the strategy and manage the Hourglass program, which focuses on identifying, assessing, and remediating privacy obligations across all of Amazon. 

Key job responsibilities

- Drive end-to-end strategy and execution of Amazon Privacy's identification, assessment, and remediation framework for privacy obligations. 

- Manage and be accountable for privacy programs and/or projects to reduce privacy and compliance risk. 

- Work across various stakeholders to identify and evaluate customer needs and solutions.

- Lead various privacy compliance activities in order for Amazon to achieve and maintain compliance with legal, policy, and regulatory standards. 

- Continuously prioritize risk for service teams, security teams, and executive leadership.

- Work with Principal Engineers and others to develop technical risk mitigation strategies and approaches. 

- Communicate clearly and effectively both in writing and verbally with team members, stakeholders, and leadership.

- Integrate into various enterprise risk management processes.

- Establish program mechanisms, KPIs, and executive reporting.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Job ID: 10538041 | Amazon Development Center U.S., Inc.

Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.



Within AAIS, Amazon WorkSpaces is our cloud-based virtual desktop service that delivers secure, managed computing to over one million daily users across the globe, enabling organizations to provision, manage, and scale desktops with the reliability and performance their workforce depends on.



We are now at an inflection point. We are transforming traditional virtual desktops into Agentic WorkSpaces a new category of intelligent persona driven workspace experiences where AI agents operate continuously alongside humans orchestrating across foundation models maintaining enterprise governance and unlocking productivity at scale. This transformation spans multiple strategic pillars from next generation architecture modernization to AI powered capacity intelligence to entirely new product constructs all converging toward a single mission: making WorkSpaces the definitive venue for human AI teamwork in the enterprise.



We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the lifecycle of the most complex cross organizational programs driving this transformation. You will manage multiple concurrent workstreams spanning capacity intelligence, architecture modernization, agentic AI integration, persona-driven workspace experiences, and new product incubation stitching together a coherent narrative for executive leadership while proactively identifying and mitigating risk across every dimension.



This is not a role for someone who waits for problems to surface. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding methodical program execution and executive influence driving clarity where ambiguity exists building mechanisms that scale cross functionally and establishing trust with VPs and SVPs across AWS and AAIS leadership.

Key job responsibilities

• Multi-Workstream Program Ownership Own end to end delivery of significantly complex cross functional technical initiatives spanning multiple organizations across science engineering product business and data engineering. Drive simultaneous workstreams including agentic AI integration, workspace persona experiences, architecture modernization, capacity forecasting and optimization, and new product incubation with clear dependencies milestones and accountability. Stitch together disparate workstream narratives into a unified coherent story for leadership reviews QBRs and S Team updates.

• Proactive Risk Identification and Mitigation Develop mechanisms to surface risk early: capacity gaps service dependencies migration blockers science to production handoff delays and timeline slips before they escalate. Own escalation paths and drive resolution at the right level. You are escalated to, not escalating up. Build data driven risk models that quantify trade offs between investment timing technical debt and customer experience informing executive decision making with precision rather than intuition.

• Technical Depth and Influence Understand system architectures deeply enough to challenge engineering teams spot risks in technical proposals and drive simplification across a portfolio that spans ML inference pipelines agent orchestration frameworks desktop streaming protocols and distributed infrastructure. Evaluate capacity plans scaling signals and architecture trade offs with confidence. Influence design decisions across service teams to unblock innovation accelerate delivery and ensure that science driven capabilities translate into production impact.

About the team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Description

Every Amazon fulfillment center, delivery station, and grocery store depends on the network gear, scanners, and devices that keep it running. Getting that hardware ordered, right-sized, and on site at the right time is still too slow and too manual. You'll build the program that fixes this, starting from a blank page.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to define and launch a new program that connects how infrastructure is planned, ordered, and fulfilled across Amazon's global operations network. Today, product teams and thousands of field associates each work with supply chain in their own way. They rely on manual handoffs and country-specific workarounds, and nobody has a single view of the process. Your job is to replace that with one governed, automated way for infrastructure demand to turn into orders, deliveries, and ready-to-install hardware.

There's no existing program to inherit. You'll set the mission, the operating model, and the integration architecture. Then you'll lead the teams that build it. You'll work with engineering teams who are already committed to this work, and with senior leaders across supply chain, procurement, field operations, and technology.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will:

- Define the program from the ground up: its charter, guiding principles, operating model, and how teams work together across organizations.

- Break down where time is lost between a customer's request and a placed order, set baselines, and target the biggest gaps first.

- Design how self-service ordering and automated bill-of-materials tools connect to supply chain systems, so orders flow without manual re-entry.

- Build a data model that handles country-specific regulations and vendor constraints as part of the design, not as exceptions.

- Set up forward-looking demand signals, so procurement moves from reacting to individual requests to planning ahead.

- Decide which systems hold the source of truth for each type of data, and which existing tools to invest in, consolidate, or retire.

- Write the strategy and present it to senior leaders, shaping who owns procurement and deployment for new site launches.

You'll love this role if you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something that doesn't exist yet, and want your work to show up in faster site launches, less wasted spend, and a better experience for teams across Amazon's operations network worldwide.

4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team

We make infrastructure simple for every team that builds and runs technology across Amazon's operations network, from fulfillment centers to quick commerce sites worldwide. We build self-service products that let customers plan, order, and deploy infrastructure on their own, make the cost of every decision visible, and support complex programs that self-service can't handle yet. Each one teaches us what to automate next. You'll join product managers, engineers, solution architects, and program managers, partnering closely with supply chain, procurement, and field operations. We work backwards from the customer, measure outcomes over activity, and give people real ownership.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

 

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.


What excites you

  • Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

  • Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

  • Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

  • Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

  • Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

  • Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

  • Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

  • Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

  • Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

  • Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

  • Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

  • Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

  • Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us:

  • Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

  • A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

  • Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

  • Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

  • Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

  • A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

  • Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

  • Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

  • A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

  • In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

  • Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

  • Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

  • Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

  • Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

  • Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.


About the Venture

We build brain-inspired computing hardware designed to tackle problems that conventional computing handles badly or not at all. Our technology has its roots in leading European research and is now a commercial system, being deployed by research institutions, supercomputing centres and companies internationally.

We are a deep-tech company moving from research-led development into a much larger commercial operation. We are scaling our hardware deployments, expanding our international customer base and building the organisation and infrastructure to support the next phase of growth.

We recently closed fresh funding, are around 70 employees in size and based out of our Dresden HQ.

About the Role

This is our first legal hire.

Legal currently sits largely with the managing directors. Your mandate is to build the legal function, establish clear decision rights and create the infrastructure that allows the company to scale without unnecessary friction.

You will own legal end to end, from corporate and commercial through to export control, IP and product regulation. The remit is broad because we sell sophisticated, regulated hardware internationally and are moving faster than our processes have historically allowed.

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the legal and operational sides of the job: not simply answering questions, but building the frameworks, processes and decision-making structures that prevent the same questions from coming up repeatedly.

What you'll do

  • Own corporate governance across our German GmbH and US entity: shareholder and board matters, financing rounds, related-party and conflict-of-interest questions.

  • Lead commercial contracting across hardware sales, licensing, research collaborations, cloud and service agreements, and NDAs. Build the templates and playbook so that standard cases can be handled efficiently.

  • Take ownership of export control and dual-use matters, including EU Dual-Use Regulation, German licensing requirements, US export-control exposure, sanctions and restricted-party screening.

  • Lead our cybersecurity and product compliance agenda, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and related incident-reporting and conformity requirements.

  • Cover product safety and market access for the hardware itself, including CE marking, EMC, RoHS, REACH and product liability.

  • Manage our IP portfolio: patents, freedom to operate, trade secrets, licensing, technology rights and trademarks.

  • Manage compliance obligations connected to public funding, including grant conditions, record keeping and audit readiness.

  • Work with People & Culture on employment matters, including contracts, terminations, employee participation structures, immigration. Data protection and GDPR sit here too.

  • Oversee open-source licence compliance and software supply-chain obligations together with engineering.

  • Build the delegation layer: signing authority, approval thresholds, decision rights and clear ownership, so that routine hiring, procurement and commercial decisions do not automatically converge on the managing directors.

  • Decide what we keep in house and what goes to external counsel, then manage those firms and the associated budget.

About You

You are comfortable being the only lawyer in the building, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a risk. You enjoy the operational side of legal work as much as the technical side.

You are direct, commercially minded and comfortable making judgement calls. You know where your own limits are and are happy to bring in specialists when the question warrants it.

  • Qualified German lawyer (Volljurist), with fluency in EU regulation.

  • In-house experience at a semiconductor, hardware or deep-tech company, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment rather than exclusively in a large corporate legal department is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with export control and dual-use questions in a business that actually ships internationally, including an understanding of the difference between licensing and per-transaction screening.

  • Comfortable across a wide surface: corporate, commercial, IP, employment and regulatory. You do not need to be the deepest expert in each area, but you need to know what good looks like and when to escalate.

  • You have built structure inside a company before: templates, approval frameworks, signing authority or something equivalent that outlived your involvement.

  • Familiarity with hardware product regulation, CE marking, RoHS and REACH, or with the evolving EU cybersecurity regime is a strong plus.

  • German and English at working fluency, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to the company's location in either Dresden or Berlin.

Why Join

You would be shaping the legal function of a company with direct access to the managing directors.

The subject matter is unusually interesting: brain-inspired computing, advanced hardware, international technology sales, export-controlled technology, research partnerships and a regulatory environment that is evolving in real time.

The work environment is flexible and inclusive, and we offer a competitive salary with relocation support for the right person. If you want to build something meaningful rather than maintain something that already exists, this is that kind of role.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams

Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions.

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture.

  • Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope.

  • Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control.

  • Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached.

  • Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning.

  • Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met.

  • Representing Wayve with partners: Lead technical discussions with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by clear interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams and decision records.

  • Leading across teams: Coordinate architects and engineering teams, negotiate competing priorities, resolve or escalate conflicts early, and mentor architects and senior engineers to build a shared architecture culture.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You bring substantial experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software or vehicle systems, particularly at the software–vehicle interface. Typically, you’ll have 12+ years of relevant experience, including architecture ownership for a complete product or multiple programs.

  • You can define clear product boundaries, ownership models and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems.

  • You understand vehicle electronics and embedded software constraints, including ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics and production vehicle software environments.

  • You’re familiar with automotive communication protocols and electrical/electronic architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP or AUTOSAR.

  • You’ve worked with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and can navigate their requirements, standards and integration constraints.

  • You’ve established and run requirements processes across multiple teams or programs, translating ambiguous needs into clear, traceable and verifiable system and software specifications.

  • You can move confidently between system-level architecture and implementation details, making sound technical decisions under uncertainty and maintaining consistency as programs evolve.

  • You’ve led architecture work across teams and influenced senior stakeholders without direct authority, building support and handling competing priorities constructively.

  • You communicate complex technical ideas clearly through specifications, diagrams and reviews, and enjoy mentoring others.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Deep-dive technical interviews

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

We hire builders with founder-level energy—people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do.

As Director, Regulatory Compliance (UK), you will serve as the senior compliance authority and strategic partner for Airwallex’s rapidly expanding UK presence. Operating as a licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) supervised by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Airwallex requires compliance leadership that sees regulatory integrity not as a roadblock, but as a critical commercial enabler and competitive differentiator.

In this role, you will lead our UK compliance framework, serve as the primary interface with local regulators and industry bodies, and work cross-functionally across Product, Strategy, Commercial, and Operations to safely launch cutting-edge payment infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UK Regulatory Compliance: Lead a UK-based team of regulatory compliance professionals; own and continuously evolve the UK compliance management system, policies, registers, and operational controls to ensure ongoing compliance with FCA handbooks, PSRs, EMRs, and UK AML/CTF regimes.

  • Drive FCA Engagement: Act as the principal point of contact for the FCA, handling regulatory inquiries, notifications, audits, thematic reviews, and routine reporting with transparency and authority.

  • Product & Commercial Advisory: Partner early with Product, Commercial, and International Expansion teams to design compliant-by-default cross-border payment, issuing, acquiring, and embedded finance architectures.

  • Safeguarding & Governance: Oversee compliance aspects of key UK regulatory regimes including safeguardingand Consumer Duty in close partnership with Finance, Risk, Product, and other teams.

  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Monitor domestic and international regulatory developments (e.g., Consumer Duty, operational resilience, PSR APP fraud reimbursement schemes) and proactively translate emerging rules into pragmatic technical and operational roadmaps.

  • Team Leadership & Culture: Build, coach, and scale a high-caliber UK compliance advisory and operations team while fostering a company-wide culture of risk accountability and ethical rigor.

  • Board & Committee Reporting: Prepare and deliver clear, actionable regulatory compliance reporting and key risk indicator (KRI) updates to executive leadership, local operating boards, and audit/risk committees.

What We’re Looking For

Essentials

  • 10+ years of regulatory compliance experience within UK fintech, payment services (EMIs/APIs), neo-banking, or modern global financial institutions.

  • Leadership Track Record: At least 4+ years managing and developing high-performing compliance teams in high-growth environments.

  • Deep Regulatory Knowledge: Expert grasp of UK financial regulations, including the Payment Services Regulations (PSRs), Electronic Money Regulations (EMRs), FCA Principles for Businesses, and Consumer Duty standards.

  • FCA Interface Experience: Direct track record of managing formal regulator relationships, supervisory inspections, or key authorization filings with the FCA.

  • Pragmatic Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements through a first-principles lens, providing creative, commercial, and defensible paths forward.

  • Executive Presence: Strong communication, negotiation, and written advocacy skills capable of influencing board members, executive partners, and external regulatory bodies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience holding an approved person / Senior Management Function (SMF) role under the FCA regime.

  • Background handling regulatory aspects of cross-border multi-currency schemes, merchant acquiring, or credit/lending adjacencies.

  • Relevant legal qualification or industry certifications (e.g., ICA Diploma in Governance, Risk & Compliance).

  • You’re commercially astute: You understand that compliance is an enabler of sustainable hyper-growth, not an isolated checklist.

  • You balance technical precision with plain-English clarity: You can dissect statutory instruments line by line, then distill the essence clearly for engineers, sales leads, and executives.

  • You’re not precious about traditional playbooks: You push hard from first principles, challenging legacy banking compliance norms with modernized, technology-driven solutions.

  • You value in-person collaboration: You thrive working shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional leaders in our London hub.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 12 Months: Institutionalize a top-tier UK compliance function that scales seamlessly with transaction volume and new market offerings while maintaining an immaculate standing with the FCA.

Why Join Airwallex

  • High autonomy to build, scale, and influence the core infrastructure powering the global digital economy.

  • Dynamic, global culture with clear paths for rapid professional development.

title: Senior Accessibility Program Manager
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

Overview

GitHub is seeking a detail-oriented individual contributor with a technical bent and experience in technical risk management who is driven to deepen that expertise. GitHub is committed to doing right by our customers and developing a highly effective control environment where risk is managed in a meaningful and sensible way that aligns with our business. 

  • Do you love the challenge of diving into the details and learning why and how things work? 

  • Do you find yourself always asking what would have to go wrong, and how badly? 

  • Do you want to see The Big Picture, and find ways to collect and organize data to tell the story? 

  • Do you suffer from a compulsive need to document things and “get it down on paper”? 

  • And last, but most certainly not least, have you already answered the question “Why are we here?” with the GRC Truth, “Because Customers”? 

 

If so, you might be the person we are looking for! 

 

As part of GRC’s Entity Risk function, you will join the Technical Risk team and partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders across GitHub to conduct capability risk assessments, develop and quantify risk scenarios, and deliver meaningful risk reporting that helps leaders make risk-informed decisions. 

Central to the team's culture is that of inclusion, transparency, and teamwork - we lift each other up to be successful! This is an excellent opportunity for an independent contributor to have a hand in elevating risk management and security as business and sales enabler as well as integrate a deeper understanding of risk management into the product and business space. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead security capability risk assessments for assigned areas, including scoping against NIST CSF subcategories, coordinating schedules and stakeholder interviews, completing maturity scoring, and publishing assessment reports. 

  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify, analyze, and prioritize technical risks, develop and quantify FAIR-style cyber risk scenarios, evaluate capabilities against established frameworks, and assess potential impacts to GitHub – our products, services, customers, and business objectives. 

  • Partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders to validate findings, identify risk patterns, and translate technical insights and stakeholder feedback into practical risk recommendations. 

  • Develop and manage risk treatment plans, drive adoption of appropriate mitigations and remediation, monitor treatment progress, and escalate unresolved or emerging risks. 

  • Maintain the risk register and supporting records in GitHub’s GRC system of record, track mitigation progress, and provide clear, recurring risk updates to technical and non-technical leaders.

Description

Amazon Robotics is seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead hardware program delivery for the Sortation Vertical. You will own the full program lifecycle for next-generation sortation hardware — from concept through engineering validation, multi-site deployment, and sustaining support in the field.

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the

idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit

right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply

advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers'

experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet.

This role sits on the Sortation Hardware Engineering team and is the single-threaded program owner for our hardware portfolio. You will drive the mechanical and electromechanical programs that deploy into Amazon's Sortation Centers at scale, working across Systems Engineering, Deployment Engineering, Solutions, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, Product, and Customer Support. You will own the program schedule, the change-control cadence, the supplier and procurement path, and the launch readiness gate — and you will be accountable when those slip.

You will be successful in this role if you are equally comfortable running a design review, chasing

a long-lead component through a contract manufacturer, and standing on a sort center floor at 6am during an install.

Key job responsibilities

• You will own end-to-end delivery of sortation hardware programs across all engineering disciplines, holding the schedule and the critical path across teams that do not report to you and driving technical decisions to closure on the record. 

• You will own the change-control cadence for the hardware portfolio, ensuring our contract manufacturers and deployment partners build to the released revision.

• You will own the procurement path for program hardware, translating supplier lead times on long-lead components into schedule risk before they become launch impacts. 

• You will own launch readiness for site deployments through the go/no-go decision and the handover to site Reliability Maintenance Engineering and Operations, and you will sustain solutions already in the field.

A day in the life

One morning you are deciding whether a bracket that does not fit stops a live install. That afternoon you are working out whether a cable assembly running three weeks late moves a launch date, and pushing a stalled engineering change through to release. Some weeks you are at your desk owning the schedule and the readiness summary leadership will read before a site goes live. Some weeks you are on a sort center floor with a tape measure. Both are the job.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical program management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field

- 5+ years of experience working directly with hardware engineering teams

- Experience taking electromechanical hardware from prototype through production and field deployment

Preferred Qualifications

- 7+ years of technical program management experience

- Experience designing or implementing integrated automation solutions such as material handling systems, high-speed packaging lines, or manufacturing lines

- 4+ years of change management experience

- Experience managing contract manufacturers and long-lead component supply chains, including translating lead-time risk into schedule impact

- Experience managing NPI validation gates (EVT/DVT/PVT) and multi-site deployment launches

- Experience with capital planning and procurement mechanics — purchase requisitions, capital requests, and vendor qualification

- Experience owning technology handover to a maintenance or operations organization

- Master's degree, MBA, or PMP certification

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence.
