description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/11/2026
Candidate must relocate or live in the listed territory

Westcoast

Meet the Team

You will join an elite, mission-driven sales organization within Cisco’s U.S. Federal Defense operation dedicated to empowering the United States Air Force and Space Force. As a Senior Account Executive supporting the US Air Force, you will play a critical role in enabling the mission readiness, secure digital modernization, and warfighter capabilities of our defense customer.

Serving as the Account Orchestrator, you will build and manage multi-year strategic relationships across designated Air Force commands and regional installations (such as Peterson SFB, Schriever SFB, Buckley SFB, Cheyenne Mountain, and the U.S. Air Force Academy). You will partner closely with Portfolio Solutions Engineers, Architecture Specialists, and executive defense leadership to drive sustainable, cross-portfolio growth and align Cisco's industry-leading technology with customer mission imperatives.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Account Orchestration & Deal Leadership: Orchestrate multi-faceted, highly complex deal cycles ($100K to $30M+) involving multiple stakeholders, defense commands, and program offices to drive impactful revenue growth and mission transformation.

Air Force Executive & Flag-Level Engagement: Engage with senior military and civilian leaders across the Air Force and Space Force, serving as the primary trusted advisor and commercial influencer in purchasing decisions.

Cross-Portfolio & Secure Networking Positioning: Drive sustainable cross-portfolio growth with deep expertise in core secure networking (enterprise switching, routing, wireless, and next-generation firewall), while collaborating with specialist teams on advanced security, cloud, and observability architectures.

Opportunity Qualification, Funnel Velocity & Forecasting: Build a robust sales pipeline through proactive opportunity prospecting; manage opportunities through all deal stages; maintain accurate representation in Cisco CRM; and analyze data to deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales commitments.

Consultative Deal Structuring & Negotiations: Lead commercial and contract negotiations with a consultative approach, expertly balancing competitive pricing, service level agreements, and multi-year federal contractual commitments (SEWP, GSA, DoD Enterprise Agreements).

Cross-Functional Teaming & Partner Teaming: Direct and align extended team resources (Portfolio SEs, TSAs, Services, RevOps, Legal, and Finance) and coordinate with defense ecosystem partners to deliver unified customer outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ to 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise technology sales, strategic business development, or defense IT account management experience.

Demonstrated track record of successfully managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles ($1M+ to $10M+) and achieving annual sales quotas.

Solid foundational knowledge of enterprise networking and cybersecurity architectures, with specific focus on core secure networking (switching, routing, wireless, and firewall).

Proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional sales engineering, product specialist, legal, and commercial teams to navigate complex federal procurement cycles.

U.S. Citizenship required to comply with federal customer site access, background investigation, and security clearance requirements.

Ability to work in a hybrid, field-based model located in or near Denver, Colorado with travel to regional military installations and partner sites.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (with 5+ years of experience), Master’s degree (with 3+ years of experience), or equivalent practical experience in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

Extensive experience selling enterprise software, hardware, or cloud solutions directly to the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), specifically the U.S. Air Force or U.S. Space Force.

Active U.S. Government Security Clearance (Secret or Top Secret / SCI).

Prior military service or experience working within defense acquisition commands (AFMC, AFLCMC, SSC, ACC, AMC, NORAD/USNORTHCOM).

Familiarity with DoD procurement contract vehicles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFARS), and multi-year enterprise software agreements (DoD ESI, 2GIT, NASA SEWP).

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Description

Are you interested in a challenge that will reward your unique blend of business and technology skills? Are you excited by the opportunity to be central in addressing significant business-impacting processes and products? Do you enjoy the challenge and ownership that comes from delivering large, cross-functional, IT projects? As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) for IT Services, you will have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in the future of IT Services. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, you will be the glue between stakeholders to ensure our customers receive the right outcomes that drive customer obsessed security. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager for the IT Services organization, you will facilitate the transition of critical IT Services used by our customers to an externalized network platform that has no reliance on a traditional private corporate style network. In this role you will be the primary point of contact for the assigned services to align customer technical requirements to the business strategy by working cross functionally. This role requires senior program and project management experience, as customer engagement, stakeholder management and effective communication is critical. This role requires you to have effective written and verbal skills as this program has director and VP level visibility. As a TIPM you will ensure projects in the program are being scoped, planned, delivered and closed in line with the agreed success measures, budget, schedule and quality. This will require you to partner with service owners and operators to determine the right business outcomes. 

Roles and Responsibilities 

- Manage and own complex projects having enterprise wide impact.

- Establish the forward looking strategy and gain support for implementation.

- Conduct pre-project requirement gathering, scoping, project approval, planning, oversee delivery and verification of strategic goals.

- Develop gap analysis, functional specifications, project schedules and milestones.

- Work with stakeholders to identify resources, assemble project teams, and assign responsibilities.

- Assess costs, benefits and risks, plus identify and respond to risks and high-priority issues rapidly and effectively through effective action and appropriate escalation.

- Balance business needs with technical and security requirements.

- Clearly communicate goals, responsibilities, issues and status to customers and senior managers.

- Lead and streamline the transition of IT Services in to production.

- Ensure changes are effectively released ensuring feedback mechanisms are established.

- Build effective relationships with stakeholder and service owners.

- Publish accurate and concise reports on time to maintain visibility and accountability.

Success in this role will require: 

- Excellent project and program management skills.

- Thrive in the face of ambiguity and not be deterred to address and prioritize multiple projects.

- Understand strategic initiatives and drive them to a successful conclusion.

- Build trusting relationships allowing you to own and drive programs.

- Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical, written and presentation skills.

- Experience with detailed project planning, reporting, risk management and measurement.

- Strong multi-tasking and influencing skills.

- Excellent organization, analytical, quantitative, and presentation skills.

- Strong bias for action and "get it done" attitude.

- Flexibility to travel, both domestically and internationally, and work within global time zones.

Key job responsibilities

The key job functions of the Technical Infrastructure Program Manager are:

- Own the identification, scoping, and delivery strategy for the Infrastructure and AV solutions in Amazon offices.

- Own projects and initiatives having regional impact, including project schedules and milestones.

- Effectively manage stakeholders to successfully deliver the agreed scope.

- Understand and identify technical obstacles to successfully deliver the designed architecture, identify and mitigate risks.

- Manage escalation, anticipate and make tradeoffs and balance business needs with technical constraints.

- Clearly communicate project and program status, responsibilities and issues to stakeholders.

The Corporate Infrastructure Services team (CIS) is part of the IT Services organization that supports all Amazonians at corporate offices. title: Sr. Engineering Security Program Manager -  Apple Service Engineering (ASE) - iCloud / China
description:
Summary
Apple is seeking an experienced engineering program manager for the Apple Services Engineering (ASE) | iCloud organization.

We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to drive and contribute to the extraordinary services and products of iCloud. 

You will partner with teams whose mission is to build, maintain, and scale the platform and product layer of Apple’s most critical cloud services in China. Your work will focus at the intersection of infrastructure, platform services, features, reliability, scalability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance.

Your work will focus on strategic leadership for all programs and work across iCloud in China. You will define the overarching program vision, drive key initiatives from planning through delivery, and maintain a clear, end-to-end view of how the many efforts across these data centers fit together, including their dependencies, risks, and priorities. 

Your work will span infrastructure, services, features, reliability, scalability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance, so you will have the opportunity to partner widely across Apple with engineering teams, operations, security, legal, and business leadership. You will be responsible for identifying, planning, and delivering critical outcomes by autonomously engaging a broad set of stakeholders, communicating program status and strategy to executives, and defining and implementing standard processes that improve our operational efficiency while upholding Apple's high standards for privacy, security, and user experience.

Description
Description
Technically curious you will autonomously lead projects of varying scale and complexity with cross-functional, geographically dispersed engineering teams with only consultative direction from leadership. 

You will influence and drive delivery from design to launch. Ensuring clarity, and establish expectations for services requested, while developing and executing processes, frameworks, metrics, and project plans, and defining scope, schedule, deliverables, and resources.
You will help teams and leaders make clear, well-informed trade-offs, operating at every level of the organization, from going deep into technical detail with engineers to representing the program to leadership and to partner teams across
Apple. Execution is critical, and you will bring the same rigor to how the work gets done as to what gets delivered.

Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's/Master's degree or equivalent work experience in project management or cloud engineering.
5+ years of experience in program or project management, successfully leading highly cross-functional software development. 
Cloud platform software and infrastructure experience, with working knowledge of software and server delivery, reliability, security, privacy, and compliance review workflows.
Fluent in software development processes (SDLC). Have personally orchestrated the delivery of multiple significant client/server software products under demanding timelines, managing multiple work streams cross-functionally across a large organization.
Collaborative engagement and technical empathy for engineers.
Sound technical foundation, including working knowledge of distributed systems concepts such as load balancing, request routing, capacity planning, and latency, and a highly motivated, self-starting approach.
Experience as a project lead, able to focus and simplify, balancing the details with goals, priorities, and trade-offs.
Consistent record in defining, maturing processes and key metrics and executing on them.
Proven leader who inspires teams, makes sound decisions, and negotiates effectively, with a track record of influencing partners without direct authority.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to filter and distill relevant information for the right audience, with strong presentation skills both in person and in multi-location meetings.
Able to think critically and creatively, identify risks, and drive execution across multiple teams to remediate them..

Preferred Qualifications
Preferred Qualifications
Experience of working on regulatory compliance initiatives, particularly China
Strong technical proficiency in client/server product development. Past programming experience is a bonus.
Experience leading large, complex programs, from requirements gathering and collaboration with teams through software development and release qualification, while maintaining a high bar for quality
Experience managing cross-org dependencies across multiple engineering teams
Experience with Supply chain and HW forecasting

Pay & Benefits
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,500 and $311,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

CSQ427R39

At Databricks, we aim to inspire our customers to make informed decisions through an intuitive platform. As a PS Technical Program Manager, you lead the success of a portfolio of complex programs and drive the continuous evolution of our delivery excellence. You are a senior leader within the PS practice, entrusted with high-visibility, large-scale engagements. Your focus is on delivering superior results and setting the standard for how we empower our customers to achieve their most ambitious data goals. This is a hybrid role based in Korea. You will be reporting to Director, Professional Services/FDE.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Portfolio Success: Own and lead a portfolio of highly complex, high-visibility programs, ensuring they remain perfectly aligned with strategic customer objectives.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive innovation and efficiency across the PS team to deliver increasingly better results for the Business Unit.
  • Strategic Alignment: Proactively coordinate technical milestones and program-level dependencies across multiple concurrent engagements.
  • Leadership Hub: Act as the primary lead for complex technical delivery discussions, collaborating with M5-level managers to ensure rapid and successful project momentum.
  • Mentorship: Elevate the entire team by mentoring junior TPMs and refining delivery processes to scale our global impact.

What We Look For

  • Experience: 5–8 years managing complex technical programs.
  • Technical Bar: Intermediate technical fluency; 1 Databricks Associate-level Certification required within 6 months of hire.
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into program management workflows to drive operational performance.
  • Process Innovation: A track record of enhancing delivery standards and implementing changes that improve operational performance.
  • Mandatory Certifications: PMP Certification (Project Management Professional) required within 6 months of hire.
  • Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in Korean and professional working proficiency in English (both written and verbal).

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:
$68,000.00 - $93,500.00

Location:
Kalispell,MT

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Key Responsibilities

Support specific project and program objectives as  defined in the areas of responsibility, and that necessary preliminary activities (e.g., determination of outcomes, milestones, viability studies, and resource planning, among others) are completed.

Support projects and programs assigned are completed in accordance with predetermined requirements, with specific attention to product/process specifications, project/program costs, resource utilization, and timeliness for completion.

Ensures that all phases of project, program and/or process development are documented and that information required in other functional areas is reported, disseminated, or transferred, as appropriate. Ensures compliance with Company policies regarding Engineering/Lab notebooks, patents, confidentiality and safety.

Undertake study of new technologies, as appropriate. 

Support data collection for materials & financial resources.

Other Requirements: This position may require standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.

Additionally, because this position also may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

Functional Knowledge

Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities

Business Expertise

Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work

Leadership

No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members

Problem Solving

Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents 

Impact

Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies

Interpersonal Skills

Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations

The NSO Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of assigned Non-System Orders (NSOs) from project release through shipment. This individual contributor role serves as the primary coordinator for complex, customer-specific system configurations, ensuring all project milestones, deliverables, manufacturing requirements, and shipment commitments are achieved.

The NSO Project Manager partners closely with the Business Management Operations (BMO) team, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, and Configuration Management organizations to manage project execution, mitigate risk, resolve issues, and ensure alignment between customer requirements and factory readiness. The role requires strong project management skills, exceptional organizational abilities, and the capacity to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of assigned NSO projects from order release through shipment.

Translate customer-specific requirements received through the BMO organization into executable manufacturing and project plans.

Develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules, key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and execution risks.

Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure engineering, manufacturing, material, quality, and configuration requirements are completed on schedule.

Serve as the central point of coordination for project scope, schedule, configuration, and readiness activities.

Drive execution of customer-specific configurations, engineering changes, BOM modifications, NSRs, CES requests, and other non-standard requirements.

Assess and communicate the impact of project changes on delivery schedules, manufacturing readiness, and shipment commitments.

Facilitate project reviews, readiness reviews, production status meetings, and issue resolution activities.

Monitor project health and performance, identifying constraints and initiating recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

Partner with Master Scheduling, Operations Management, and BMO teams to prioritize deliverables and maintain execution alignment.

Lead risk identification and mitigation activities, ensuring project risks are proactively managed and escalated when necessary.

Coordinate resolution of manufacturing, quality, material, and engineering issues affecting project execution.

Support shipment readiness activities, including final test coordination, documentation reviews, and production release requirements.

Maintain accurate project documentation, action-item tracking, schedule status, and project metrics.

Provide timely status updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans to stakeholders and leadership.

Identify and implement process improvements that enhance NSO execution efficiency, predictability, and customer delivery performance.

Success in This Role Requires

Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.

Ability to manage multiple highly customized projects simultaneously in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, change management, configuration management, and production planning processes.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across multiple functional organizations.

Proven ability to manage risk, resolve conflicts, and maintain commitments in highly dynamic project environments.

Additional Information

Time Type:
Full time

Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular

Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:
No

The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

title: Agentic AI Senior Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Senior Consultant based in Switzerland.

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on engineering expert, helping enterprise customers design, implement, and scale advanced agentic AI solutions. You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the technical success of enterprise customers' agentic AI initiatives, managing the complete delivery lifecycle from initial discovery and solution design through development, production deployment, ongoing operations, and advisory services.
  • Lead customer workshops to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value agentic AI use cases, translating business objectives into measurable and technically achievable workflows.
  • Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent architectures, including agent decomposition, orchestration, task delegation, tool integration, memory management, state handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Develop, review, and troubleshoot production-quality software using Go or Python, building agents, plugins, tools, and integrations that meet enterprise requirements.
  • Deploy and operate agentic AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and legacy systems through MCP servers, A2A protocols, REST APIs, and event-driven messaging architectures.
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, knowledge bases, embeddings, and real-time event context strategies to improve agent accuracy and access to relevant information.
  • Apply the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) throughout solution delivery, covering requirements gathering, architecture design, evaluation pipelines, testing, version control, release management, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Establish robust observability, security controls, governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices for agentic systems, including tracing, quality evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control, and auditability.
  • Advise customers on large language model selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, considering prompt engineering, token consumption, costs, and model performance trade-offs.
  • Act as a long-term technical advisor, identifying opportunities for further AI adoption and helping customers progress from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide, event-driven AI implementations.
  • Conduct recurring technical reviews, solution health checks, and roadmap discussions aligned with customer priorities and annual planning cycles.
  • Enable customer engineering teams to independently operate, maintain, and extend implemented solutions through technical workshops, collaborative development sessions, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Develop reusable technical assets, including reference architectures, implementation patterns, accelerators, and best practices, to improve delivery efficiency and consistency across future engagements.
  • Represent customer needs and technical feedback to internal Product and Engineering teams, contributing insights that influence product development and roadmap priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with agentic AI platform engineering teams to resolve complex customer challenges, validate new capabilities, and contribute reusable agents, plugins, and accelerators.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other professionals, helping strengthen agentic AI expertise and delivery capabilities across the Professional Services organization.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, AI-related risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Travel when required to support customer engagements, including occasional international travel.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in professional services, technology consulting, systems integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions, including at least one solution successfully taken into production.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management, with practical experience applying a structured Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC).
  • Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with Go considered a significant advantage.
  • Practical experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making.
  • Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with agent interoperability and tool integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, and designing APIs for agent-based applications.
  • Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and context management techniques.
  • Experience implementing evaluation frameworks, observability solutions, and security guardrails for enterprise LLM applications.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience deploying distributed applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of enterprise security and identity management practices relevant to AI systems, including OAuth 2.0, role-based access control (RBAC), secrets management, and data privacy.
  • Ability to independently lead customer engagements, make sound technical decisions, and manage complex projects with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience facilitating technical workshops and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English and either Spanish or Italian, both written and spoken.
  • Experience working with agentic AI platforms or enterprise messaging technologies is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Solace Agent Mesh or similar agentic AI platforms is a plus.
  • Proficiency in both Go and Python is an additional advantage.
  • Experience with messaging technologies such as Solace, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ, or TIBCO is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of LLM platforms and services, including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini/Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Foundry, is desirable.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or MLOps practices, including prompt and model versioning, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring, is a plus.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and regulatory requirements in industries such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector is advantageous.
  • Experience using AI-assisted and agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including the ability to demonstrate and share these practices with others.
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, and enterprise integration architectures is beneficial.
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified Machine Learning or Generative AI, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, are considered an advantage.
  • Previous experience creating technical workshops, reference architectures, blogs, presentations, or demonstrations focused on agentic AI is a plus.

title: Senior Scrum master
description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

  • Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.


  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

  • PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

  • Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

  • Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

 
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

title: Supply Chain Lead
description:
Build the supply chain behind technology that is already operating at scale.

We’re partnering with a fast-growing defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.

This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.

The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As production and international operations expand, they are now building a more resilient and scalable electronics supply chain across Europe.

We’re looking for the Supply Chain Lead to build and own this function.

The Role:

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll take ownership of the electronics supply chain end-to-end from EMS strategy and semiconductor sourcing to BOM resilience, logistics and cross-border operations.

This is not a procurement coordination role or an established function to simply maintain.

You’ll help determine where and how products are manufactured, how critical components are secured, which EMS and semiconductor partners the company builds around, and how the supply chain scales with production.

For someone coming from the European semiconductor, electronics or EMS ecosystem, this is an opportunity to move from owning one part of a mature supply chain to building one with significant autonomy and direct access to decision-makers.

Responsibilities:

  • Source and manage EMS partners

  • Manage BOM risk, including allocation, EOL, pre-buys and alternates

  • Own the mechanical cooling strategy and plant standards, including air-cooled solutions, chilled water systems, liquid cooling integration and hybrid deployment approaches.

  • Define modular mechanical building block principles that support scalability, phasing flexibility, resilience and STACK’s platform design philosophy.

  • Provide senior technical review at key RIBA stage gates, challenging consultant designs for compliance with standards, energy efficiency, constructability and operability.

  • Review and approve structured deviations from mechanical standards, ensuring design decisions are clearly governed, documented and aligned with platform objectives.

  • Support regional design and delivery teams with complex mechanical issues during design, PCSA, construction and commissioning phases.

  • Provide technical input into client specification reviews and support structured responses to changes in rack density, inlet temperatures, flow rates and other hyperscale requirements.

  • Monitor emerging cooling technologies, higher-density deployments and AI-driven load growth, helping define a future-ready roadmap for liquid cooling and next-generation mechanical systems.

  • Support sustainability and energy optimisation initiatives, including plant sizing, PUE performance, capacity planning and improvements that enhance MW yield and platform competitiveness.

  • Partner with commercial, development and investment teams to explain mechanical CapEx drivers, quantify the impact of specification changes and support informed decision-making.

  • Develop and maintain mechanical design standards, technical guidance notes, Basis of Design alignment, QA checklists, peer review frameworks and BIM-related mechanical requirements.

What You'll Bring

 

  • Significant experience in mechanical engineering within mission-critical, hyperscale data centre or similarly complex technical environments.

  • Strong understanding of data centre cooling strategy, resilience, scalability, partial-load and full-build-out assumptions, energy efficiency and PUE optimisation.

  • Experience in a developer, hyperscale, investor-backed or large-scale infrastructure platform would be beneficial.

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world's most innovative companies, designing, developing and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Every payment we process runs on infrastructure we built. We are genuinely multi-cloud, and we are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who is too - a strong generalist who treats infrastructure as a software problem and can deliver from week one.

This is a hands-on senior role in an established, fast-moving team. Everything we run is defined in code, deployed through pipelines, and reviewed like software. You will bring deep cloud expertise across AWS and Azure and pair it with a genuine software engineering mindset: you write Terraform modules others build on, you automate away toil rather than documenting it, and you treat the platform as a product with users, SLOs, and a roadmap.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you are responsible for the technical delivery of your team's services. You will work closely with your Engineering Manager to shape direction, manage dependencies across pillars, and ensure our platform meets the standards a regulated payments business demands.

Deep AWS expertise: Advanced, hands-on experience designing and operating production infrastructure in AWS at enterprise scale: multi-account architectures (Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs), IAM, KMS, and the core compute, storage, and security services that a large regulated estate runs on. You should have a proven track record of delivering resilient, multi-region architectures.

Azure experience: Real production experience with Azure alongside AWS: landing zones, VNet architectures, Entra ID, and the Azure resource and governance model. You understand where the two clouds differ and can design well for both rather than forcing one cloud's patterns onto the other.

Software engineering mindset: You treat infrastructure as software. Expert-level Terraform: reusable modules, secure state management, and disciplined code review. Experience: 5+ years in cloud engineering roles with significant AWS depth. We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

title: Senior Treasury Manager
description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We are looking for a Senior Treasury Manager to build and run Finom's treasury function.

Finom safeguards a significant book of customer funds across its regulated entities. Net interest income on that book is a meaningful revenue line, and it will grow. Today the function is up and running: the money is placed, the investment policy is in place, and a large part of the book sits with an external asset manager. What we are building now is the machinery around it — an evidenced limit framework, look-through into what our managers actually hold, automated investment accounting, and a reconciled NII number we can defend to an auditor and a regulator.

That is the job. You will take part in building it, and you will run it while it is being built.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of regulation, liquidity, and commercial impact — not a back-office position. It suits someone who has done this before in a regulated environment and wants to do it again without four layers of committee above them.


What you'll own

Liquidity and funding

  • Daily liquidity positioning and float management across entities and accounts
  • Intraday funding of payment channels; nostro and correspondent account management
  • Collateral and minimum-balance obligations across card schemes, T2, and credit providers
  • Contingency funding — the playbook for the day we need €20m by tomorrow morning
  • A daily treasury balance sheet — net liquidity and net capital available — that reconciles

    • Safeguarding and portfolio

  • Portfolio management of safeguarded client funds: term deposits, MMFs, short-dated debt, held directly and via external managers
  • Safeguarding adequacy: shortfall detection, top-up execution, same-currency discipline
  • Instrument eligibility screening under CRR risk-weight, maturity and WAL constraints, and UCITS/MMF rules
  • Independent, evidenced validation that externally managed allocations sit inside mandate — position-level look-through, daily monitoring of concentration, maturity, WAL and credit quality, breach escalation
  • NII forecasting, attribution, and reconciled performance reporting; treasury inputs into the financial model and company forecast

    • Governance and controls

  • Ownership of the investment policy, limit framework, and eligible-instrument register
  • Treasury governance: decision pack, agenda, decision log, and delegated-authority register
  • Pre-deal checks and post-trade evidencing, designed so that the first line executes and the second line challenges
  • Covenant tracking across credit facilities
  • Regulator, external audit, and second-line engagement on treasury and safeguarding matters

    • Systems and data

  • Selection and implementation of investment accounting and treasury tooling — a Clearwater/Advent-class implementation is already in flight and will be yours
  • Custodian, asset-manager and bank data feeds; API connectivity where it exists and pragmatic alternatives where it doesn't
  • Replacing manual spreadsheet processes with something that survives your holiday

    • Commercial

  • Bank, custodian, broker and asset-manager relationships: onboarding, commercial terms, mandate setting, service review
  • Challenging our managers on allocation, transparency and fees — and changing them if the answers are weak

    • What good looks like in the first 12 months
  • Investment policy and limit framework live, with treasury governance running on a documented decision log
  • Daily, evidenced mandate compliance across the full book — we can answer "are we inside the boundaries?" in minutes, not weeks
  • Investment accounting platform implemented; monthly close on the portfolio no longer manual
  • An NII number that is reconciled, attributed, and forecastable
  • A contingency liquidity playbook that has been tested rather than written

    • Who you are
  • 5+ years in treasury, ALM, fixed income, or portfolio management at a regulated financial institution, EMI/PI, or asset manager
  • Direct experience with client money or safeguarding under PSD2 / EMD — core to this role, not adjacent to it
  • Experience building or materially rebuilding a treasury function, not only operating inside an established one
  • Strong command of bond math, yield and duration, MMF mechanics, and credit and concentration risk at instrument level
  • Track record of automating manual treasury processes and implementing treasury or investment accounting systems
  • Comfortable working with position-level data directly — you can interrogate a portfolio file rather than wait for a report
  • Experience with regulators, external audit, and external asset managers (mandate setting, IMA terms, performance challenge)
  • Sound judgement under time pressure in a lean environment with real accountability and limited cover
  • Strong Excel skills
  • Fluent English
    •  

    Nice to have

  • Familiarity with IFRS 9 or Dutch GAAP (RJ 290) financial instrument accounting
  • SQL or Python
  • Experience in a firm transitioning toward a banking licence
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, copilots) to accelerate analytical and reporting workflows

title: Fleet Operations Traing Lead, UK
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

As the Fleet Operations Training Lead, UK, you will lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training across our Fleet Operations teams. You will ensure that team members have the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence required to operate safely, consistently, and effectively.

 

Working closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other teams across the business, you will identify capability gaps and translate complex operational and technical information into engaging, practical learning experiences. You will establish consistent training standards across both regions while adapting programs to reflect local operational, cultural, language, and regulatory requirements.

 

We’re looking for someone who is organised, collaborative, and passionate about developing others: a pragmatic leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, safety-focused environment and can balance immediate training needs with a longer-term strategy. As our Fleet Operations function grows, you will develop scalable training programs and processes that can support additional geographies in the future.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive training strategy and roadmap for Fleet Operations in the UK, aligned with organisational priorities, operational requirements, and future geographical expansion

  • Design, implement, and regularly update onboarding, technical, safety, compliance, and professional-development programs for Fleet Operations teams

  • Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and subject-matter experts to assess skills, identify capability gaps, and prioritise training requirements

  • Deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, practical, and blended learning experiences for employees with different levels of experience and technical knowledge

  • Establish consistent training and competency standards while adapting content and delivery to local languages, cultures, regulations, and operational environments

  • Create structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs that ensure employees are prepared to perform their roles safely and effectively

  • Define and monitor measures such as participation, knowledge retention, practical proficiency, time to competency, learner feedback, and operational performance

  • Use performance data, employee feedback, incident trends, and operational insights to continually improve training content, methods, and outcomes

  • Develop and manage train-the-trainer programs, supporting local trainers and Fleet Operations leaders to deliver learning consistently and effectively

  • Use learning technologies to make training accessible, scalable, and engaging, while maintaining accurate records of training, competency, and certification

  • Work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other stakeholders to ensure training reflects current technology, processes, risks, and business priorities

  • Support the introduction of new technologies, vehicles, processes, policies, and programmes through structured training and change-readiness activities

  • Champion continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development across Fleet Operations

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Developing and delivering onboarding, technical, safety, and professional-development training

  • Building and maintaining competency frameworks, learning paths, and certification programs

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to ensure training keeps pace with operational and technological change

  • Evaluating training effectiveness using participation, performance, and feedback metrics

  • Running train-the-trainer initiatives and supporting local training delivery

  • Continuously iterating on training content, standards, and processes, making improvements based on data and feedback

  • Supporting operational change by creating learning experiences for new tools, vehicles, and systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You have a strong track record of developing and implementing comprehensive operational training programs, including training-needs analysis, instructional design, delivery, and evaluation

  • You have demonstrated leadership experience within a high-velocity, safety-focused fleet, operational, or technical environment

  • You have experience supporting training across multiple locations, regions, or culturally diverse teams

  • You have excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational information clear and accessible

  • You have experience creating structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs

  • You have strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify capability gaps and evaluate the effectiveness and operational impact of training

  • You possess strong stakeholder-management skills and can collaborate with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and subject-matter experts

  • You have excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, with proven ability to respond effectively to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment

  • You are able to work effectively across Europe and travel between operational locations when required

  • You are available to work on-site five days a week

  • You have a clean and compliant driving record in accordance with company requirements

  • You have a safety-conscious mindset, with the confidence to identify and escalate potential risks

 

Desirable

 

  • Experience establishing or scaling training programs across multiple countries or geographical regions

  • Experience adapting training for different languages, cultures, regulatory requirements, and operational contexts

  • Familiarity with learning-management systems, digital learning tools, and virtual or blended learning approaches

  • Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or leading a distributed network of trainers

  • Familiarity with advanced driver-assistance systems, including sensors and onboard hardware and firmware

  • Experience in fleet operations, particularly data collection and closed-loop testing of ADAS functions

  • Experience working within the automotive, autonomous-vehicle, robotics, AI, mobility, or another safety-critical industry

  • Japanese-language capability or previous experience working closely with teams in Japan

  • Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:


Key Responsibilities

  • Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

  • Create narrative-driven, longform video content, including stylized and explicit NSFW visuals, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and visual coherence throughout

  • Own and manage end-to-end AI video production workflows, from ideation and prompting to generation, editing, and post-production

  • Utilise tools such as Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse and other AI video models/platforms to produce high-quality visual sequences

  • Develop and maintain consistent character appearance, style, and scene continuity across longer narratives using advanced techniques

  • Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

  • Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques, incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

  • Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

  • Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality


Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art, with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

  • Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

  • Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines, including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

  • Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

  • Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content


Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!
